digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified Gate voting and messaging
propositions: Cancelled or timed-out mutation jobs produce a Verified -1 vote with message 'CANCELLED: <run URL>' that names neither the job nor the reason, requiring manual triage to distinguish timeout from other failures
The upstream gerrit-review-action hardcodes its message format and exposes no input for custom text, so triage detail cannot be delivered through that action
A new summarize_ci_failures.py script maps job payloads and check-run annotations to one-line summaries per non-successful job (job name, TIMED OUT vs CANCELLED vs FAILED, duration, url)

The vote workflow must post a comment-only review via SSH gerrit review --message to Gerrit carrying the job summary, guarded on vote-type != success and ordered after the vote is cast so vote failure is impossible
Both the job summary step and key cleanup must be continue-on-error and execute after the vote is already cast, preserving the vote outcome even if summary posting fails
